value.body:
The per-repo job aggregation filtered on the three `github.*` ref kinds,
omitting `tangled.create-repo` -- the kind enrollment and resync actually
enqueue. A create-repo job that was retrying or sitting at `failed` could
therefore never move a repo to `behind` or `error`.

One line plus a comment in `dashboard.get.ts`. The kind already carries
the same `installationId`/`githubRepoId` payload shape, so the existing
grouping is unchanged. No dependency on any other fix.

Tests: full unit suite passes. No tests added: the change is a kind
string inside the raw `sql` filter in the `dashboard.get.ts` route
handler, and no route handler in this repo has unit coverage -- the suite
targets utils and pure functions. The consumer of that query's output,
`repoHealth()`, is already covered directly.
value.title: fix: count tangled.create-repo jobs in the dashboard aggregation
